description: Persona smoke expectations for 'dunkin' (Rick's PR #108 second review: moved out of shared C# -- tests/conformance/tests/Conformance.Tests/PersonaSmokeTests.cs -- so no brand-specific literal lives there; a data-only pack PR adds only this file). Loaded by PersonaSmokeExpectations.For(personaId). Every field must be sourced from this SAME persona's own pack files, never invented: greetingSubstring from personas/dunkin/prompts/greeting.yaml, and searchableOwnItem/orderableItemName/orderableItemSize/orderableItemPrice from personas/dunkin/menu/menuItems.json (the size/price pair must match that file's entry exactly, or the add-to-order smoke step fails). orderableItemName names 'Glazed Donut' (Donuts & Bakery, happyHourDiscounted:false) rather than a Signature Latte or Cold Beverage item, since PersonaSmokeTests.cs asserts the charged price equals this exact menu price and the smoke fixtures run on the real wall clock (not a FixedClock), so a happy-hour-eligible item's price could vary depending on when the suite runs. Note (known gap, flagged not fixed -- out of a data-only pack PR's scope): this file's schema (PersonaSmokeExpectations.Expectation, five fields only) has no happy-hour extension point, and no shared C# fixture currently proves ANY real pack's own inside/outside-window happy-hour discount+banner behavior generically -- the shared real-pack happy-hour price-conformance tests are all hardcoded to a different persona's own menu items, and the per-persona-config happy-hour proof added by #108/#113 is scoped only to the test-alpha/test-beta fixture packs, not real packs discovered under personas/. Dunkin's happyHourDiscounted eligibility and its persona.json announce/banner fields are unit-tested at the Python level (app/backend/tests/), but real-pack happy-hour behavior over the wire is exercised end-to-end only for one other real pack today -- a real pack-count-agnostic version of that shared fixture would need a shared-code change beyond this PR's scope.
greetingSubstring: Welcome to Dunkin! How may I help you today?
